name: ASADO FIRE GRILL RESTAURANT
description_short: Flame-grilled steaks and burgers meet sports-bar energy at this family-friendly Keurboomstrand favourite.
description_long:
Set along the main road in Keurboomstrand, ASADO Fire Grill delivers exactly what its name promises: honest flame-grilled food in a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere. The open kitchen lets you watch steaks sizzle over the fire while the sports-bar vibe keeps things lively without overwhelming families settling in for a proper meal.

The menu covers all the bases — juicy burgers, wood-fired pizzas, and proper grilled steaks that don't pretend to be more than they are. It's the kind of place where you can bring the kids for a casual Sunday lunch or meet friends for cocktails and a game on the screens. The Keurboomstrand location puts you close to the beach, making it a natural stop after a day in the sun.

What works here is the straightforward approach: good grills, cold drinks, and a team that keeps things moving without fuss. Whether you're after a quick burger or settling in for the evening, ASADO strikes that rare balance between casual and satisfying.
